ops.title: Owner Slack replies were recorded twice: two writers
ops.body: Each owner DM reply made two owner records (cci 552113/552130, 552230/552254, Nov 6). register_capture.py stamp_owner_prompts posted id slack:<ts> with attrs ts/thread for every DM reply (since #2222, Nov 3), and lr owner watch / thread-word posts owner:<row> with attr row for each fresh ledger row (since #3013, Nov 4). #3013 moved the owner-record writer into lr without removing the hook's post. cc-skills#3676 (87d3910) removed the hook post; lr is the one writer, one record per ledger row, idempotent by owner:<row>. It also dropped thread-word's card-answer:<ts> record (#3652), since the row record now carries card=<id>. The free-text replies were unrouted because the first thread was a cc-slack card copy (no card in lr's index; cc-slack#172 adds thread_card) and the second a reply-tool thread (rmw5coyh9, PR #48159) that is no card. card_takers had owner-relay as taker on 122 of 371 cards because desk lanes took any card they mentioned; #3676 stops that.
